name: Tradegate AG Wertpapierhandelsbank
summary: Tradegate AG Wertpapierhandelsbank provides various financial services in Germany, operating as a market specialist on the Tradegate Exchange and Frankfurt Stock Exchange, order book manager on the Berlin Stock Exchange, and market maker on EuroTLX, alongside issuing mini-futures certificates and lending services. Founded in 1986, headquartered in Berlin, Germany.
